title: Pocket TTS adapter
summary: Adapter for Kyutai Pocket TTS (lazy import, model loaded once, voice states cached) returning mono float32 audio; lists the English built-in voice names.
description: Pocket TTS code is MIT per its repository (checked 2026-10-10); the README links model and voice licences separately and they were not verified here. Check them before publishing.

side_effects: pocket-tts may download model weights and voices from the Hugging Face Hub on first use and cache them

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
